# Field Day Lab

> > Field Day Lab creates NGSS-aligned educational games and simulations for K-12 science, history, and media literacy education.

Based at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, Field Day Lab develops research-backed learning games including The Yard Games collection, BrainPOP partnerships, and award-winning titles like Jo Wilder. Led by David Gagnon and team, the lab conducts educational research on game-based learning and data mining while collaborating with organizations like PBS Wisconsin, Wisconsin Historical Society, and Wisconsin Sea Grant.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- Educational games research
- Middle school science education
- The Yard Games collection
- BrainPOP partnerships
- Wisconsin DPI collaboration
- Game-based learning
- Multiplayer science simulations
- David Gagnon (Director)
- Free browser-based games
- PBS Wisconsin partnerships
- Grades 6-12 curriculum alignment
- Data mining in education
- Science cycle simulations (water, carbon, nitrogen)
- Wisconsin Virtual Schools

## Research & Collaboration

- [Research - Field Day](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/research): Educational games research on learning, data mining & game design
- [Work with Field Day](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/work): Research partnerships & grant collaboration opportunities with Field Day

## Featured Learning Games

- [Jo Wilder and the Capitol Case](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/jowilder): Wisconsin history detective game with PBS & Historical Society
- [Lakeland](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/lakeland): Town-building game teaching phosphorus cycle & lake pollution systems
- [The Legend of the Lost Emerald](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/emerald): Great Lakes maritime archaeology game with PBS & Wisconsin Sea Grant
- [On the Ice: Weather Station](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/on-the-ice): Antarctica VR game for Oculus Quest teaching polar climate science
- [Headlines and High Water](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/headlines): Journalism adventure game teaching media literacy & news writing

## Science Cycle Games (The Yard Games)

- [Water Cycle Game](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/water-game): NGSS-aligned multiplayer water cycle game for middle school science
- [Carbon Cycle Game](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/carbon-game): Free multiplayer carbon cycle board game for middle school science
- [Nitrogen Cycle Game](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/nitrogen-game): NGSS-aligned multiplayer nitrogen cycle board game for middle school
- [Magnet Hunt](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/magnet): Yard Games magnetism education game for middle school science
- [Wind Simulator](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/wind): NGSS-aligned weather education game from The Yard Games collection
- [Hot Air Balloon](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/balloon): Free browser game teaching buoyancy & air pressure concepts

## BrainPOP Science Simulations

- [Water Cycle Simulation](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/water-sim): BrainPOP water cycle simulation for grades 6-12 science education
- [Rock Cycle Simulation](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/rock-sim): BrainPOP partnership geology simulation for middle & high school
- [Plate Tectonics](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/plate-tectonics): BrainPOP magma flow & tectonic plates simulator for grades 6-12

## Biology & Earth Science Simulations

- [Antibiotic Resistance](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/antibiotic): Bacteria simulation game teaching antibiotic resistance & heredity
- [Atom Touch](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/atom-touch): Open-source molecular dynamics simulation for thermodynamics education
- [Earthquake!](https://fielddaylab.wisc.edu/play/earthquake): Seismic wave triangulation simulation for middle school earth science
